# Draft plan, issue #4824 (planner's notes)

## Found so far
- `redact` (crates/ai/src/observe.rs ~544) resets seed/rng_cursor/applied, keeps `next_id`.
- next_id mints: `c{n}` instances (state.rs new_instance, zones.rs:921, flicker.rs:18, duos/reduce.rs:164),
  `q{n}` prompts (prompts.rs:335, setup.rs:57), `e{n}` echoes (echo.rs:71), `secret-{n}` (effects/secret.rs:65).
  `numbering_order` (state.rs:3391) keys a stream on seed+next_id (seed is "redacted" there anyway).
- Transient def ids `t-{n}:` do not use next_id (fuse.rs next_transient_id).
- determinize mints nothing. duos.rs:580 reads the probe's (redacted) next_id: consistent after fix, no edit.
- Placeholders keep real ids. decide reads true state only in ai_to_act + submitted (trial of the chosen action).
- Issue's tests at commit 3f48455 `crates/ai/tests/audit_fuzz.rs` (local: `git show 3f48455:crates/ai/tests/audit_fuzz.rs`).
- mutate_hidden in crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs ~104; add next_id bump at end.
- Ruling: new R4824000 + spec/pending/4824.md; edit R0185.md ("the match seed and the event history"),
  crates/ai/README.md line ~56 ("the seed, the event history"). Pattern: commit c0b4971 (#4803).
- No patch fragment needed (AI-only change; claims are about cards).

## Fix shape
At END of redact (after all scrubbing, before `next` returns), `next.next_id = first_unnamed_id(&next)`:
one past the highest number of any string or object key in serde_json::to_value(&next) shaped
`c<digits>`, `q<digits>`, `e<digits>`, `secret-<digits>`. Computed last so idempotent (redact_twice) and only
reads what the redaction keeps.

## Experiment (scratch worktree /tmp/wt-4824, detached; delete when done: `git worktree remove --force /tmp/wt-4824`)
- applied the fix + issue's audit_fuzz.rs; running `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test audit_fuzz` ... (pending)
- then run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features jackioh-engine/testkit` to see which pinned tests move.

## Risk
Normalized counter < true counter in nearly every mid-game state (answered prompts' q-ids vanish), so simulated
prompt ids / minted ids shift -> decisions may change in pinned AI tests.
